name: B10-0070/2025 (ESN) – Case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Jean-Jacques Wondo, a Belgian-Congolese military expert sentenced to death in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to have new evidence of his innocence fully considered by the Court of Appeal. It also warns that lifting the ban on executions, combined with a weak justice system, raises the risk of arbitrary killings. Finally, it asks the European Union to withdraw or redirect its support for the country's security and justice sectors.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states positions and makes requests; no law or decision changes.
- **Who it affects:** Wondo, other death-row prisoners in the DRC, and EU aid programmes there.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and the DRC's government and parliament; they decide whether to act.
